claim: For binary three-dimensional functional batch codes in which every request in every five-request multiset has a pairwise-disjoint recovery set of size at most two, the minimum length is exactly \(11\). Equivalently, a \([11,3,5,2]\) code exists and no \([n,3,5,2]\) code exists for \(n\le 10\).
integrity: The lower bound is a finite combinatorial consequence of the seven nonzero column types in F_2^3; the upper bound is exhaustively checked over all 462 query multisets by the supplied standalone verifier.
scientific_limitations: Binary linear dimension three only; five requests; locality two. No classification of optimal codes beyond the verified witness and supplemental multiplicity census is claimed.
title: Exact length eleven for five-request binary functional batch codes with locality two
